cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Be There for Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to show up, help, or stay involved as proof that the connection still matters.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Come paint the old kitchen with me. Since Dad died, I barely see you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll pay someone. I can't face painting over his height marks.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. We'll keep them. Come help me tape around them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll probably just sit on the floor and cry.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll sit with you. We can leave the paint unopened; I don't want us only meeting to empty his house.

mechanism: A copies a social or practical custom incorrectly to seem at home, then uses new clues to persuade B to stay involved as proof of connection.
confusable: D74 delays departure until repair; D73 asks presence/help as proof connection still matters, without requiring a quarrel.
comparison: Shared activity between rarely meeting friends versus father at an art opening.
seedUse: Preserve B vulnerability or social discomfort as an opportunity for a more workable shared role.
